title: Lid-driven cavity vs Ghia et al. (1982)
description: A lid-driven cavity solved with PINNeAPPle's local vorticity-streamfunction engine (numpy/scipy, no GPU) and checked against the centreline profiles of Ghia, Ghia & Shin (1982): 64x64 at Re = 100 and 128x128 at Re = 1000, in about 23 s on one CPU core. `--engine pict` runs the same case on PICT (CUDA) when it is installed; the output names the engine that produced the numbers.

metrics.name: ghia_u_rms_re100
metrics.how: rms of u(x=0.5) against Ghia et al. (1982) Table I at Re=100, 64x64 cells, local engine

metrics.name: ghia_v_rms_re100
metrics.how: rms of v(y=0.5) against Ghia et al. (1982) Table II at Re=100, 64x64 cells, local engine

metrics.name: continuity_re100
metrics.how: largest discrete du/dx + dv/dy, normalised by the lid velocity over the side

metrics.how: largest discrete du/dx + dv/dy, normalised by the lid velocity over the side
